english.title: Owner fail to ask issuing body to modify / update equine's ID
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), failed to ask the issuing body to modify or update the ID when you believed that identity details contained in the equine's ID, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..), required modification or updating
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 8, 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
